visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a dark red t-shirt and loose black trousers stands in the center of a brightly lit indoor living room. He holds a red yo-yo and begins a series of complex spinning maneuvers. In the background, a large crystal chandelier hangs above a dining table, and various shelves with collectibles are visible. (2) The scene cuts to a black leather sofa where three young women are seated. One woman in a pink top looks on with a surprised facial expression, while the others watch intently, one holding a smartphone to record the performance. The lighting is warm and even throughout the room. (3) The performer executes intricate string manipulations, creating geometric shapes with the red yo-yo string while moving his body rhythmically. The camera uses handheld movements to follow the dynamic motion of the yo-yo. (4) Close-up shots highlight the man's concentrated facial expression and precise hand gestures as the yo-yo travels around his limbs. The background shows several Nintendo console boxes and gaming peripherals. (5) The performance concludes with the man catching the yo-yo and smiling. The women on the sofa are shown clapping their hands enthusiastically, with one giving a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female vocals immediately shout "What the fuck!" with high pitch and excitement. No BGM is present in the first second. (2) Fast-tempo electronic pop music kicks in with a rhythmic synth lead and 4/4 drum beat. Multiple female voices are heard laughing and shouting "Wow!" repeatedly. (3) The vocal intensity remains high as voices continue to react with "Oh my god!" and "What!". The music maintains a consistent, upbeat energy. (4) Distinct sounds of rhythmic hand clapping join the mix, synchronized with the peak of the cheering. One female voice provides a commentary in Mandarin with a friendly, animated tone. (5) The music continues until the end, accompanied by sustained applause and concluding praises like "超強的" (Super strong) and "很厲害" (Very impressive) with high positive valence.
